tokens.name: dracula-background
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Background. Source of `surface`; text on bright fills (`on-primary`, `on-tertiary`, `on-rec`).

tokens.name: dracula-selection
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Selection. Source of `secondary-container` (selected rows, tonal buttons) and `surface-container-highest`.

tokens.name: dracula-comment
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Comment. Source of `outline` and the seek bar's buffered range. 3.6:1 on Background — borders and marks only, never small text.

tokens.name: dracula-foreground
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Foreground. Source of `on-surface` and all text on dark containers.

tokens.name: dracula-purple
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Purple. Source of `primary`.

tokens.name: dracula-cyan
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Cyan. Source of `tertiary` (network statistics).

tokens.name: dracula-green
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Green. Source of `success` (connected, healthy).

tokens.name: dracula-orange
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Orange. Source of `warning` (partial captures, low disk).

tokens.name: dracula-red
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Red. Source of `rec` and `error`.

tokens.name: dracula-pink
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Pink. Not assigned to a role yet; the next categorical hue if a third stats series is added.

tokens.name: dracula-yellow
tokens.usage: Dracula PRO Yellow. Source of `highlight` (search-match highlight).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Key actions and active state: filled buttons, seek-bar progress, active icon buttons, focus ring. As text, use only on `surface`, `surface-container-low` and `surface-container` (≥4.5:1); as a ring or icon it holds 3:1 up to `surface-container-highest`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills (5.2:1).

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal purple emphasis: the cover's player slab, active quality option. Derived from Purple's hue (250° 35% 30%).

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-container` (10.7:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis marks: buffered range on the seek bar, inactive switch handle.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary` (Comment) fills, any size: 4.56:1. Dracula Background's hue darkened to near-black, since no light text reaches 4.5:1 on Comment.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Selected library row, tonal buttons, active filter chip.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary-container` (9.2:1).

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Network-statistics series (bandwidth, buffer sparklines) so network reads apart from video stats in `primary`.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on `tertiary` fills (13.2:1).

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Info banners and the 'Processing' status chip. Derived from Cyan's hue (170° 35% 22%).

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text on `tertiary-container` (7.9:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Connected / healthy states: the dot on the connected Twitch account chip. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons and text on any surface: low disk space, retries.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on `warning` fills (10.6:1).

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: The 'Partial' status chip. Derived from Orange's hue (35° 40% 22%).

tokens.name: on-warning-container
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-container` (7.0:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on any surface (failed segment loads, auth failure), always with ⚠ or a word.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on `error` fills (7.5:1).

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Failure chips (Twitch session expired) and destructive confirmation banners. Derived from Red's hue (10° 40% 24%).

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text on `error-container` (5.5:1).

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: Recording-in-progress signal: the REC dot, the live-edge tick on the seek bar and the REC chip fill. Shares Red with `error`; REC is always the pulsing dot or the REC label.

tokens.name: on-rec
tokens.usage: Text on `rec` fills (the REC chip label, 7.5:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Search-match highlight behind matched characters in library titles.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on `highlight` (15:1).

tokens.name: twitch
tokens.usage: Fill of the Connect-with-Twitch button only — Twitch's brand purple, kept exact. Close in hue to `primary`; told apart by its white label and the Twitch wording.

tokens.name: twitch-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of the Twitch button.

tokens.name: on-twitch
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `twitch` and `twitch-hover` (4.6:1 and 6.3:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind the top app bar and main column.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Behind the player column in theater mode (Background's hue at 10%).

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: The library drawer background (250° 15% 17%).

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Stats panel and recording-details card background (250° 15% 19.5%).

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Search field, menus, hovered list rows, stat tiles (250° 15% 23%).

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Thumbnail placeholders, slider tracks, avatar fallbacks.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Tooltip ground under `on-surface` text (8.2:1); dialogs.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and surface-container step (≥9:1).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, durations, stat labels, inactive icons. Comment lightened to 250° 25% 75% so it reads as text: ≥4.6:1 on every surface step and on `secondary-container`.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined button, chip and text-field borders (≥3:1 on `surface` through `surface-container`).

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: list dividers, card borders. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar ground (e.g. 'Recording deleted · Undo').

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on `inverse-surface`.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text inside snackbars (7.4:1 on Foreground).

tokens.name: player-bg
tokens.usage: The video element and letterbox area. Always pure black.

tokens.name: player-scrim
tokens.usage: Flat scrim strip behind the player's control bar and title overlay.

tokens.name: on-player
tokens.usage: Icons and timecode over `player-scrim` / `player-bg`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal scrim behind the drawer on narrow layouts and behind dialogs.

styles.name: title-large

styles.name: title-medium

styles.name: title-small

styles.name: body-medium

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Dates and durations in library rows; helper text.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Player timecode and thumbnail duration badges (tabular figures).

styles.name: stat-value

styles.name: stat-hero
styles.usage: Headline value on a stat tile (buffer health, bandwidth).
